Construction.value: SAB2024 p206 identifies the exterior solarium wooden leaf within translucent glass held by the same metal-profile family as the entrance. Modern-restoration photograph p207 figure11 supports a central opaque leaf, split sidelights on both sides and a full-width transom. Coarse20/60/20 widths and88percent leaf height are inferred, not original measurements; swing direction is unresolved. The35mm five/25/five timber-skin and hollow-batten family is inferred for this roof leaf from the general p203 timber construction, not individually measured.
Construction.source: SAB2024-p206; p207-figure11 modern Jorge Ramos photograph
